facts.text: Tommy Bahama Miramonte Resort & Spa is the first resort from the Tommy Bahama brand.
facts.excerpt: Tommy Bahama Miramonte Resort & Spa is the first resort from the Tommy Bahama brand.

facts.text: The resort sits on 11 acres of olive trees and citrus groves in Indian Wells.
facts.excerpt: Sitting on 11 expansive acres of olive trees and fragrant citrus groves, Tommy Bahama Miramonte Resort & Spa in Indian Wells, CA

facts.text: The resort has sweeping views of the Santa Rosa mountains.
facts.excerpt: boasts sweeping views of the Santa Rosa mountains

facts.text: Rooms and suites are designed with woven textures, organic tones and Tommy Bahama's signature prints.
facts.excerpt: Each room and suite is thoughtfully designed with woven textures, organic tones, and Tommy Bahama's signature prints

facts.text: There are four uniquely themed Villa Suites with exclusive Tommy Bahama furniture.
facts.excerpt: The Villa Suite is a first-class getaway experience with four uniquely themed Villa Suites, exclusive Tommy Bahama furniture

facts.text: The Grand Marlin Suite, the resort's most luxurious suite, features custom pieces from the exclusive Tommy Bahama Palm Desert furniture collection.
facts.excerpt: Featuring contemporary custom pieces from the exclusive Tommy Bahama Palm Desert furniture collection, and woven raffia details throughout

facts.text: Spa Rosa is a full-service spa offering massages, facials and body treatments in a private courtyard setting.
facts.excerpt: Spa Rosa is the resort’s full-service spa, offering massages, facials, body treatments and restorative experiences in a private courtyard setting.

facts.text: Spa Rosa facilities include eucalyptus steam rooms, a hydrotherapy jacuzzi, a saltwater pool and an outdoor spa terrace.
facts.excerpt: Spa facilities include eucalyptus steam rooms, a hydrotherapy jacuzzi, saltwater pool, private locker rooms, plush robes and slippers, and an outdoor spa terrace.

facts.text: The Spa Rosa River Bench has private waterfalls and nooks for privacy.
facts.excerpt: the intimate River Bench boasting private waterfalls and nooks for privacy set at 102 degrees

facts.text: The Hideaway Pool is tucked away within the resort and has sun decks and a heated whirlpool.
facts.excerpt: Our Hideaway Pool is tucked away within the resort to create a serene atmosphere and is equipped with sun decks and a heated whirlpool.

facts.text: Private cabanas are available by reservation at the Chiki Palm Pool.
facts.excerpt: Private cabanas are available by reservation at the Chiki Palm Pool.

facts.text: With over 100 citrus trees on the resort, guests can borrow a fruit picker and basket to pick their own fruit.
facts.excerpt: Borrow a fruit picker and a basket to enjoy the fruits of your labor. With over 100 citrus trees resort wide, experience picking your own fresh fruit.

facts.text: Grapefruit Basil's olive grove patio has seating woven between mature olive trees.
facts.excerpt: savor every bite on the olive grove patio, where seating is woven between mature olive trees

facts.text: Live acoustic sets play in the Olive Grove every Thursday through Saturday.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in island vibes with live acoustic sets every Thursday through Saturday from 6pm - 9pm.

facts.text: The resort is moments from Indian Wells Golf Resort and a short drive from PGA WEST.
facts.excerpt: Located moments from Indian Wells Golf Resort and a short drive from PGA WEST®

facts.text: The Indian Wells Tennis Garden, host of the annual BNP Paribas Open, is minutes from the resort.
facts.excerpt: The Indian Wells Tennis Garden is just minutes from the resort and hosts the annual BNP Paribas Open.

facts.text: Palm Springs International Airport is about 15 miles from the resort.
facts.excerpt: The resort is approximately 15 miles from the airport, with drive times typically around 25 minutes depending on traffic.

facts.text: The resort does not currently advertise a complimentary airport shuttle.
facts.excerpt: The resort does not currently advertise a complimentary airport shuttle.

facts.text: Guests must be at least 18 to access Spa Rosa.
facts.excerpt: Guests must be at least 18 years old to access Spa Rosa and its facilities.

facts.text: The resort welcomes well-behaved dogs, with a maximum of two dogs per room.
facts.excerpt: Yes. The resort welcomes well-behaved dogs and currently lists a $100 fee per stay, with a maximum of two dogs per room.

facts.text: The resort fee includes a daily two-hour bicycle rental for up to two guests.
facts.excerpt: Yes. The resort fee currently includes a daily two-hour bicycle rental for up to two guests.

facts.text: The Miramonte King Room is on the second floor, accessible by staircase, with no balcony or patio access.
facts.excerpt: Located on the second floor of our island-inspired, two-story buildings, accessible by staircase. No balcony or patio access.

facts.text: The resort has bocce courts.
facts.excerpt: our bocce courts keep you entertained when you don’t feel like wandering far

facts.text: The resort is a non-smoking property, including its pool areas.
facts.excerpt: Tommy Bahama Miramonte Resort & Spa is a non-smoking property, including its resort pool areas.
